people.name: Гвин
people.look: A weather-worn shepherd in a quilted work jacket, who has a name for every one of her sheep.

people.name: Осрик Хейл
people.look: A reeve in a good brown coat and a mohair scarf, the common chest's tally sticks always under his arm.
remembers: You told him who took the toll at the bridge.

people.name: Браннок
people.look: A tired warden with a staff, a faded red armband and a stub of chalk behind his ear.
remembers: You gave him a sack of wheat for a pitch by the well.

people.name: Одда Велл
people.look: A broad, weathered woman in a man's oilskin coat, with a halter rope of plaited baler twine, who talks to her horses more than to people.
remembers: You gave the warden a sack of her wheat.

people.name: Седж
people.look: An old woman in black knitted fingerless gloves, with a crow on her shoulder and a basket of knotted charms.
remembers: You took one of her charms.

people.name: Руфус
people.look: A young man in a very good coat over a thin roll-neck.
remembers: You let his wagon pass.

people.name: Фенн Ласк
people.heard: They say every sack and every debt in the valley is written on his clipboard.

people.name: Бел Коррин
people.heard: They say a seat at her fire costs no coin, only a story.

people.name: Кол
people.heard: They say the goblins took the whole flock from the brothers on Bald Hill this autumn.

people.name: Данн
people.heard: They say wherever his brother goes, he goes.
